Name: Krobus Sells Unlimited Iridium Sprinklers Daily
Author: tazzerrat
Description:
[size=6][b]Krobus Sells Unlimited Iridium Sprinklers Daily?[/b][/size]
[size=4]So instead of sleeping several times and walking back and forth just to get one Iridium Sprinkler, you can install this mod and buy it whenever you need it.[/size]

[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Unlimited stock
• Available daily
• No price change (10,000g)[/size]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[size=3]• [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
• [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url]
[b]
[/b][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[size=3]• Unzip and drop the mod folder named "[CP] Krobus Sells Unlimited Iridium Sprinklers Daily" into ...Stardew Valley/Mods[/size]﻿

[size=5][b]Q[/b] "How did you do this?"[/size][size=5]﻿
[b]A[/b] "[url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Shops]Well let me tell you...[/url]"[/size]
